title: From Nonsmooth Minima to Smooth Branches via Heat Kernel Regularization
summary: Many optimization problems in science and engineering involve objective functions that are nonsmooth at their minimizers. A common strategy is to trace a branch of minimizers of a regularized objective as the smoothing scale tends to zero; however, for nonsmooth functions, it is generally unclear whether such a branch can be continued and whether the associated continuation equation remains locally solvable.
